aboutP1: Imbulunga ikhombisa amasonto amaKatolika, amashaphele, izindawo ezingcwele, amabasilika namakhathedrali angu-{n} avela ku-{a1}imininingwane yezindawo ye-Overture Maps{end} (ukukhishwa {release}), eqoqa izindawo ezivela ku-Meta, Microsoft neminye imithombo evulekile.
aboutP2: Izindawo ezingu-{cat} zibhalwe ku-Overture njengezindawo zokukhonza zamaRoma Katolika. Ezinye ezingu-{name} zibhalwe njengezindawo zokukhonza zamaKrestu kuphela; imbulunga iyazifaka ngoba amagama azo asobala ukuthi angamaKatolika (isb. “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Imininingwane yazo inombhalo.
aboutP3: Akukabi khona uhlu oluvulekile oluqukethe wonke amapherishi. Ukufakwa kungcono emazweni aseMelika naseNtshonalanga Yurophu, kuncane ezingxenyeni ze-Afrika nase-Asia, lapho amapherishi amaningi engakabi semephini. Okunye okubhaliwe kungaba okuphindiwe, amahhovisi noma izakhiwo ezivaliwe. Uma uvula isonto, ikhasi lifuna isithombe salo ku-{a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} naku-Wikipedia ngendawo nangegama, futhi likhombisa umthwebuli. Amasonto angenazo izithombe anomdwebo. Ikhadi ngalinye lingavula ezinye izithombe, amavidiyo ne-Street View.

about_seasonAdvent: I-Adventi ingamaviki amane angaphambi kukaKhisimusi, lapho iBandla lilungiselela ngokulindela okujabulisayo ukuza kukaKristu: likhumbula ukuzalwa kwakhe eBhethlehema futhi lilindele ukubuya kwakhe enkazimulweni. Umbala wayo onsomi; ngeSonto le-Gaudete ngopinki.
about_seasonChristmas: Isikhathi sikaKhisimusi sigubha ukuzalwa kweNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu, kusukela ngoKhisimusi kudlula i-Epiphani kuze kube uMbhabhadiso weNkosi. Umbala waso omhlophe, wenjabulo nenkazimulo.
about_seasonOrdinary: Isikhathi Esivamile yingxenye yonyaka engaphandle kwe-Adventi, kaKhisimusi, kweLenti nePhasika. Amaviki aso anezinombolo, futhi iBandla lilandela impilo nemfundiso kaKristu iviki nangeviki. Umbala waso oluhlaza, wethemba nokukhula.
about_seasonLent: ILenti iyizinsuku ezingamashumi amane zokukhuleka, zokuzila nokupha abampofu, kusukela ngoLwesithathu Lomlotha kuze kube ngoLwesine Olungcwele, lapho abathembekile babuyela kuNkulunkulu ngokuphenduka futhi belungiselela ukugubha iMfihlakalo yePhasika. Umbala wayo onsomi; ngeSonto le-Laetare ngopinki.
about_seasonHolyWeek: IViki Elingcwele liqala ngeSonto Lamagatsha, lapho iBandla likhumbula ukungena kweNkosi yethu eJerusalema, futhi liholela ezinsukwini ezintathu ezingcwele zokuHlupheka kwayo, ukuFa nokuVuka. ISonto Lamagatsha libomvu; izinsuku zeviki zinsomi.
about_seasonTriduum: I-Triduum Engcwele yePhasika, kusukela eMiseni Lesidlo SeNkosi kusihlwa ngoLwesine Olungcwele kuze kube kusihlwa ngeSonto lePhasika, iyisiqongo sonyaka wonke weLithurgi: ukuHlupheka, ukuFa nokuVuka kweNkosi.
about_seasonEaster: Isikhathi sePhasika siyizinsuku ezingamashumi amahlanu kusukela ngeSonto lePhasika kuya ePhentekoste, esizigubha njengeSonto elilodwa elikhulu lenjabulo eNkosini evukile. Umbala waso omhlophe; ePhentekoste obomvu.
